summary: E2E testing of the new 'Evolución del rendimiento' clickable cards + Progress Detail Modal (PDF + share link) + Public Progress page. All 5 frontend flows and 4 backend endpoints PASS against the public preview URL. The 1RM card for athlete 'sds' (3 seeded records: 110/115/120 kg) opens the modal correctly; PDF downloads work both from authed modal and from the public page; share link generates a valid /progress/p/{share_id} URL that loads without login and matches the expected dark-themed public report.
critical_code_review_comments: AthleteProgress.js (~220 lines) is clean, single-responsibility, with full data-testid coverage (athlete-progress, athlete-progress-card, progress-detail-modal, progress-chart, progress-record-row, progress-pdf-btn, progress-share-btn, progress-share-url). No code-quality issues.

PublicProgress.js correctly fetches /api/calculator-results/public/{id} without auth header and renders dark-themed report. PDF download passes window.location.origin so backend can embed correct QR. data-testid 'public-progress' and 'public-progress-pdf' present.
Token retrieval uses localStorage.getItem('train_token') consistently — matches the rest of the app.
Minor (informational, not a bug): downloadPdf() in modal uses simple `catch` for clipboard / fetch — silently fails to error toast. Acceptable.
Backend POST /share correctly returns 'No hay registros para compartir' when label/calculator pair has no data (verified via curl with wrong label).

success_rate.backend: 100% (4/4 endpoints: progress-pdf 200 + PDF, share 200, public 200, public/pdf 200 + PDF)

seed_data_creation: Did NOT create or delete any seed data. Athlete 'sds' (id 8eaadfb1-9228-4fdc-a495-6fd382400f6f) still has its 3 seeded calc-1rm records (110, 115, 120 kg) intact as requested. One share link was generated for tests: share_id=201ff32c31ae (these are persistent in DB by design — main agent may clean up if desired).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Endpoint base: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://lordcoach-optimize.preview.emergentagent.com. Login: /login → fill email/password → submit (no separate landing click needed when going to /login directly). Path to athlete progress: top nav [data-testid='tab-datos'] → click text 'Plan Deporte General' → click text 'Información' → click text 'Atletas' → click first [data-testid^='athlete-fab-'] containing 'sds'. The athlete profile renders [data-testid='athlete-progress'] with N cards [data-testid='athlete-progress-card']; clicking opens [data-testid='progress-detail-modal'] which contains 5 stats, [data-testid='progress-chart'], 3 [data-testid='progress-record-row'], [data-testid='progress-pdf-btn'], [data-testid='progress-share-btn'] + [data-testid='progress-share-url']. Public route: /progress/p/{share_id} renders [data-testid='public-progress'] with [data-testid='public-progress-pdf']. Toast lib: sonner.
rca of the issue: N/A — feature works end-to-end. Note for backend: the calculator id in DB is 'calc-1rm' (not 'one_rm') and the metric label is '1RM Promedio' (not '1RM Promedio Ponderado'). Frontend reads these directly from saved results so consumers don't need to know them, but any curl-based regression must use the actual values.
